meta.title: Translation Assistant
meta.description: Translation workspace with paragraph and sentence comparison, .txt/.md/.html/.docx file import with downloadable output, and a model picker in the header grouped by provider (follow the profile default or pin one model). Edit any translation, have AI redo it with your instruction, or turn a score and its feedback into one more pass, translate text from an image, keep a searchable on-device history with pinning, and edit, copy, or score the full text. Scores stay hidden until you ask, and every AI pass leaves a revision you can roll back to.
